PLAN "Bodyweight + Bar 12-Week Strength"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Foundational full-body strength with minimal equipment"

PHASES
  PHASE "Base Foundation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Lower Push + Core":
        warmup:
          jumping jacks 3m
        main straight_sets:
          squat to chair 4x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          reverse lunge bodyweight 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          wall sit 3x30..45 seconds rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          calf raise single-leg 3x10..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          dead bug 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          side plank 3x20..30 seconds rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring stretch 3m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Upper Pull + Push":
        warmup:
          arm circles 3m
        main straight_sets:
          inverted row doorway 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          pull-up band-assist or eccentric 5x2..4 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          push-up incline 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          pike shoulder tap 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          doorway face pull towel 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest doorway stretch 3m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Full Body + Core":
        warmup:
          high knees low impact 3m
        main straight_sets:
          hip hinge good morning bodyweight 4x10..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          split squat supported 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          push-up knee 3x10..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          hollow hold 3x20..30 seconds rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
          scapular pull-up 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
